review_description: I've had a great experience with Bar Plumbing—they're reliable, professional, and easy to work with. Definitely a team you can count on when you need a plumber.
Efficient install, very happy with James and his team. Many thanks

I called James and he was so friendly and knowledgeable. The quote was very reasonable and he didn't try to upsell me on anything, he was just honest about what he thought would work for me and my family. The install was quick and easy and everything was left clean and tidy.
Highly recommend Bar Plumbing! Professional, reliable, and efficient service. The team was knowledgeable and got the job done quickly with great attention to detail. Will definitely use them again
